lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Whoa! I got a star! What did I do?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: You put an onion in the pot. Stars tell you 'that was good, do it again!'

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... so if I want more stars, I do more of that?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Exactly. That's called a reward.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: I always go this way. It's... a long way, but I know it.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Ooh, what's that? I found a shortcut!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Trying something new is called exploring. Sometimes it's a mess, sometimes you find something better.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: After lots of practice, they have a plan in their heads. That's their strategy.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: I know where to go every time!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... I'm sure about the onions, but not the plates yet.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: The clearer the bubble, the surer they are.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Welcome to my kitchen! Have you ever made onion soup? Let's make one together.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: First, grab an onion.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Now drop it in the pot.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Let it cook for a bit.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Grab a plate.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Serve it right here!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: You did it! That's a perfect bowl. You're officially a Soup Master!

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Hi! I'm Wendy, nice to meet you! Ooh, is that soup? It smells amazing!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... hello. I'm Kai. We're new here... could you show us how to make soup?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: They're my new apprentices. They can't learn just by watching. They learn from stars. Every time they do a step right, you give them a star. Will you teach them?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Pick the steps that deserve a star, then press Train.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Onions! More onions! I love onions!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... I think we have too many onions...

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: I want a star... but how do I get one?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: It took them a long time to find their first star.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: We did it! Soup's up!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: See? They learn whatever you reward. Nice work!

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: I know you gave me stars for soup... but what's over there? I just have to check!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Wendy, wait for me!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: They're very curious. Try turning their curiosity up or down.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Wheee! Everything is so interesting!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... I'll just stay here. I don't want to try anything new.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: If they never try anything, they never find a star.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: A little curious at first, then focused. That's how they find the best path. Trying lots of things at the start really helps!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Wow, you taught them well. Ready for the soup contest? First, how sure are you that we'll win?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Now let's ask Wendy and Kai.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Totally! I know exactly where the onions are!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... I'm not so sure about the plates...

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Here's a secret: nobody can make soup alone in this kitchen. You two have to work together!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: You'll play as Wendy. Kai is counting on you. Ready... cook!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: We actually did it!

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Best team ever!

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Um... that was hard. I'll do my best next time.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Let's try again! I know we can do it!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Close! Want another round?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Two bowls wins. You're so close!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Remember our very first soup? Onions, pot, cook, plate, serve!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: In AI words, the cook is the agent. The kitchen is the environment.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Each moment in the kitchen is a state. Each move you pick is an action.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: And the right order of actions makes the soup!

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Level one was all about rewards! A reward is like a gold star.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: When I only got stars for onions, I just piled up onions. Zero soup!

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: So reward design matters. You learn what you get rewarded for.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Good rewards, like small stars for each helpful step, taught us much faster.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Level two was about exploring. It means trying new things.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: With zero curiosity, we kept bumping into walls. No soup at all.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: So at first, try a lot. Later, use what works best. That's exploitation.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Trying, and trying again, is how we learned. That's training!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Level three asked a big question: is the AI sure?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Each action has a value. That's a guess of how good it will be.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Solid bubbles meant sure. Dashed bubbles meant not so sure.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: If our confidence is low, don't trust us too much. Think for yourself!

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Level four was teamwork! You played me, and Kai cooked beside you.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: Two agents working together is called multi-agent cooperation.

lines.speaker: wendy
lines.text: The team score is my score plus Kai's score, added up.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Sometimes you get fewer stars, but the team does better. That's okay.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Now you know how AI learns. Great job, little chefs!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Well hello there, friend! Welcome, welcome!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: I'm Dingo, head chef of this little kitchen. What's your name?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: What a great name, friend. So happy to meet you!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Today's a big day. My two little apprentices are learning to cook, and I need a helper. That's you!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Let's make some yummy onion soup together. Ready? Follow me!

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Nice work, friend! Now Wendy's turn. Can you teach her with stars?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Wendy's learning! But Kai never wants to try new things... let's help him explore.

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: Curious cooks find new tricks! Now, how sure are they about their moves?

lines.speaker: dingo
lines.text: They're almost real chefs! Time for the big soup contest. Let's go!
